title: Why the page is slow
question: The page takes seconds. Where did the time go?
summary: The three places the time usually is: a component rendering more often than anyone meant, a query per row, and an index the planner would not use. One slice across React and the database, because that is how the bug arrives.

steps.note: Render cost and re-render count are two different problems. Separate them first.
Nobody tells you which of the three it is. That is the exercise.
